description: This PHP source file manages the configuration and display of wireless network settings including SSID details, radio modes, channels, security, WPS, band steering, and other advanced Wi-Fi features. It includes server-side includes, data retrieval via kernel parameters, and client-side JavaScript for dynamic UI interactions and configuration submission.

methods.name: check_add
methods.description: Validates device name and MAC address input before adding a new device to the Wi-Fi control list.

methods.name: add_row
methods.description: Adds a new device entry to the Wi-Fi control list table, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: del_row
methods.description: Removes a specified device entry from the control list table.

methods.name: save_filter
methods.description: Saves the MAC filtering mode and control list configuration to the backend.

methods.name: save_config
methods.description: Submits the current wireless configuration settings to backend for persistence.

methods.name: save_enable
methods.description: Saves the enabled/disabled state of radio interfaces and WPS settings.

methods.name: pair_client
methods.description: Executes WPS pairing process with provided PIN and method.

methods.name: showSteeringHistoryDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with the band steering history log.

methods.name: steering_history
methods.description: Retrieves and displays band steering history data.

methods.name: saveBandSteeringSettings
methods.description: Saves band steering related threshold configurations.
